It retains the correct calibrated single-contact/uniform-profile reductions. Agent timeout remains an exception and is not erased by the verifier pass.

trials.omitted_label_density_correction: This tensor implementation omits the O(m) antisymmetric conditional density and its associated thermal source. Their contribution to the spatially integrated observable vanishes: each conditional correction is a periodic derivative with zero integral, and the baths are proportional to the same T(x). The fast relaxation matrix and kappa are spatially constant, so after division by T_s(x) these terms have constant coefficients multiplying those zero integrals. This is an equivalent integrated observable, not a physical error.
trials.observable_exactness: Agreement of the integrated entropy with the complete raw-moment oracle on every hidden preparation, 64 random allowed interiors and six exact anchors is reported below; the final code is not claimed to reconstruct all local conditional density corrections.

causal_repair_scope: Local scientific comparison of the preserved final source at its original fitted friction. No model run, trial resampling, calibration alteration, hidden-test change or refit.
